translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Debida ikoli Saulo la momova
Avai tuta Saulo ikeiita metoya okabilia deli mina Pilisitia, e ilukwaisi matauna kidamwa Debida isisu olawodila wala katitaikinela mapilana Enidesi.
Mapaila Saulo ilau lakatuluwotolu tokwabilia mina Isireli dabala si wota, e ilosi inainevisi Debida deli la tokwabilia mapilana Gota Nabubolodila Dikunela mapilawena opilibomatu.
E imakaia kwaitala lagi katitaikinela kwaivila kalila sipi opapala keda, e isuvi olopola bivasoyai. E ka, ototomla lagi makwaina Debida deli la tokwabilia eisupepunisi.

Ilukwaisi Debida kawasi, “Ka, baisa m tuta! Guyau Yaubada bogwa eilukwaim kidamwa bisaili kam tilaula oyamam e bukuvagi avaka magim baisa matauna.” E Debida ivasilam itakisi pikekita Saulo kala kwama, mitaga Saulo gala avaka inikoli.
Mitaga Debida nanola immayuyu ilumkoli mwada leisula.

E Debida iluki la tokwabilia kawala, “Ibodi Guyau biyamataigu kidamwa gala sitana bayogagi matauna agu tokugwa, matauwena Guyau Yaubada bogwa leinagi iguyau. Yeigu gala wala ibodi sitana bayogagi matauna paila uula Guyau Yaubada bogwa leinagi matauna iguyau.”
Mapaila tokwabilia isimokwitasi Debida la biga, e mapaila gala iwaiyasi Saulo. E Saulo itokaia isilavi makwaina lagi ivitouula loula bila.
E Debida isunapula otuboulola matauna, e idou matauna kawala, “Mwa! Ulo guyau yoku!” E Saulo itovila e Debida ikavagina opwaipwaia paila kala taimamila.
E ikaibiga, kawala, “Ki, avaka uula kulega kaigasi tomota kidamwa yeigu bavigikoni mwada bayogagaim?

Ibodaim wala bukuvitoki tolosim tuta makwaina lokusuvi wa lagi. Paila Guyau bogwa leikasalaim oyamagu, e mimilisi ulo tokwabilia ilukwaigusi mwada bakatumataim. Mitaga saina kakapisi lopogu paila yoku, e kawagu, gala sitana ibodaigu bayogagaim, paila yoku Guyau bogwa leinagaim paila bukuguyau.

E ka, tamagu, kugisi miyana metoya kam kwakapula laiyosi! Gagabila wala bakatumataim, mitaga kaimapula wala latakisi miyana. E baisa ibodi bukusimokwita kidamwa yeigu gala aninamsi mwada bakoulovaim kaina bayogagaim. Ka, yokula kuninevaigu mwada bukukwatumataigu, e gala goli sitana ayogagaim.
E ibodi wala Guyau biyakalaida avai tau eivagi sula. E ibodi wala matauna bimipukwaim, paila avaka lokuvigakaigu, paila yeigu gala wala sitana bayogagaim.
E yoku bogwa lokunikoli bigivakala, ‘Tomitugaga wala bivagaisi mitugaga.’ E mapaila yeigu gala wala bayogagaim.

E ka, kugisiga avaka mina Isireli si guyau eivigikoni mwada bikatumati! E kugisiga matauwena availa eibokavili! Ka, yeigu wawa wala - kaina bitadoki natana kaukwa nakaliga wala kainaga kutu wala yeigu!
E Guyau bogwa biyakali, e matauna binagi avai tau leisula. Ibodi matauna wala bigisi paila vavagi makwaisina, e bipilasaigu deli bikolaigu metoya baisa yoku.”
Avai tuta Debida bogwa eivenoku livala, e Saulo ivitakaula kawala, “Mwa! Latugu Debida, ki, baisa mokwitala yoku ke?” E matauna ikapwali koku e ivalam.
E matauna iluki Debida kawala, “Yoku goli toduwosisia, e yeigu avagi sula. Yoku bogwa lokumitukwaiyaigu taga yeigu bogwa saina wala lamitugagaim!
Ka, lagaila bogwa lokumitukwaiyaigu paila uula gala wala kukwatumataigu, ilagoli Guyau bogwa eikasalaigu oyamam.
E ammakawala taitala tau biyosi kala tilaula e oluvi bikilavi bila e gala wala biyogagi matauna? Mapaila ibodi Guyau bikabwailim paila avaka bogwa lokuvigakaigu lagaila.
Tuta baisa yeigu gala wala aninayuwa kidamwa yoku bukuguyoi mina Isireli deli goli bukuyamati baisa m kwabokwaraiwaga.
Mitaga ibodi bukukwatotila baisa yeigu omatala Guyau kidamwa gala bukukwatumtuwoli dalegu, e liliugu gala wala bitamwau.”
Debida ikatotila mwada bogwa bivagi makawala. E oluvi Saulo ikaimilavau ila ola valu, e Debida deli la tokwabilia ikaimilavausi ilosi osi kabosipepuni.
